CapCut used to caption for free. Now saving can ask for Pro. If captions are all you need, this page does that one job: pick a clip, pick a look, fix a word, save.

What it does not do

  • English only.
  • Three looks, no templates or stickers.
  • Not an editor: no cutting, music or filters.
Is CapCut auto captions free?

You can try it, but saving can ask for Pro. CapCut's help page says that prompt shows because auto captions "includes Pro-only functionality". CapCut help, 3 April 2026

Can I caption without CapCut Pro?

Yes. Free up to 60 seconds with a small mark, or $19 once for no mark and clips up to five minutes. Our terms

Is my clip uploaded?

No. It stays on your device, and there is no account. Our privacy page
